definition: the part of a garment that covers the arm
description: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

en.question: What is the man taking off?

phrases: sich bis auf die Thermounterwäsche ausziehen
de.question: Was zieht der Mann aus?

es.answer: Se está quitando la ropa de invierno.
es.question: ¿Qué se está quitando el hombre?
